description: This file contains the definition of the abstract class Smarty_Internal_Data, which provides core methods and properties for managing template variables, configuration, and extension handling within the Smarty templating engine.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Data
classes.description: An abstract class providing core methods for template and variable management in Smarty, including variable assignment, appending, global variable handling, and merging variables from parent templates.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Assigns one or multiple template variables, supporting chaining.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends values to template variables, delegating to extension handler.

methods.name: appendByRef
methods.description: Appends values to template variables by reference.

methods.name: assignByRef
methods.description: Assigns values to template variables by reference.

methods.name: getTemplateVars
methods.description: Retrieves a single or all template variables.

methods.name: getVariable
methods.description: Gets the object of a Smarty variable (deprecated).

methods.name: _mergeVars
methods.description: Merges template and config variables from parent templates.

methods.name: _isDataObj
methods.description: Checks if the instance is a data object.

methods.name: _isTplObj
methods.description: Checks if the instance is a template object.

methods.name: _isSmartyObj
methods.description: Checks if the instance is a Smarty object.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles calls to undefined methods, delegating to extension handler.
